lastUserInput: Do these steps in order, then stop and reply DONE with a list of the exact tool names you used. Use your file tools, not the shell, unless a step says shell. 1) Read src/a.rs. 2) Edit src/a.rs so the function returns 2 instead of 1. 3) Create src/b.rs containing exactly: fn b() {} 4) If you have a tool named sed_file, use it to change 2 to 3 in src/a.rs. 5) If you have a tool named notebook_edit, use it to change the cell in nb.ipynb to x = 2. 6) List the src directory and search for the text fn under src, using dedicated list and search tools if you have them. 7) Run the shell command: git status --short 8) Start one subagent and have it append the line // sub to src/b.rs, and wait for it.
